provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled centered right-angle detection geometry with exact prescribed inner-filter relation F_observed=F_intrinsic*10^[-(A_excitation+A_emission)/2]. Each absorbance is independently measured for the same sample/cell. No dynamic/static quenching, changes of detector gain or scattering. The corrected quantity is an intensity proxy, not a quantum yield or concentration-normalized brightness.
target: Apply the declared geometry to both samples and compare intrinsic versus observed rank. Do not use excitation absorbance alone or divide by absorptance to create an unrequested quantum-yield estimate.
